title: 🌳 Balanced Tree
description: 🔍 The longest path from root to leaf contains 3 nodes.

title: 🌿 One-Sided Tree
description: ➡️ The only path contains 2 nodes, giving a depth of 2.

title: 🍃 Empty Tree
description: 🌱 An empty tree has no nodes, so its maximum depth is 0.

title: 🌲 Single Node
description: 🎯 A tree with only the root node has depth 1.

title: 🌴 Left-Skewed Tree
description: ⬅️ The longest left-side chain contains 4 nodes.

title: 🌴 Right-Skewed Tree
description: ➡️ The longest right-side chain contains 4 nodes.

title: 🌳 Uneven Tree
description: 🧭 The deepest route reaches 4 nodes from the root to the farthest leaf.
